title: Gabriel Luna Is Now Open to Returning as Ghost Rider in the MCU
excerpt:
The Robbie Reyes actor has reconsidered his previous reluctance to revisit Ghost Rider.
No official Marvel return has been announced.
body_md:
Gabriel Luna says he is willing to play Robbie Reyes again after previously expressing concern that revisiting the character could undermine his work on Agents of SHIELD. He portrayed the supernatural hero in ten episodes of the show's fourth season.

A proposed Hulu spin-off centered on Ghost Rider never materialized, leaving Luna's portrayal without a direct continuation. At the time, he felt the original story was strong enough to stand on its own.

The expansion of Marvel's multiverse changed his thinking. Luna also pointed to the enduring enthusiasm of fans at a tenth-anniversary celebration as an important reason for reconsidering his position.

He believes an older, more mature Robbie Reyes could provide a natural direction for the character, and says he remains physically prepared for the demands of the role.

Rumors about a Ghost Rider appearing in a future Avengers lineup remain unverified. A potential Midnight Sons appearance is likewise speculation rather than an announced production.
